settings.content: Swatches, left to right: Cobalt, Ink, Butter, Coral, Bone, Chalk. Colors you add with + go at the end. Every color picker in the theme shows these swatches; a color picked from them shows as "Palette color" and stays linked, so changing a swatch here updates every scheme and setting using it. Cobalt is the signature ground; Ink is the deepest ground and text on light; Butter and Coral are punctuation only, never section-sized fills; Chalk and Bone carry type. Up to 20 colors.

Every section picks one of these schemes. Edit a scheme and every section using it changes. The editor numbers them: Scheme 1 is Chalk, 2 is Bone, 3 is Cobalt, 4 is Ink. Readable pairs: Ink on Chalk or Bone; Cobalt on Chalk or Bone; Bone or Butter on Cobalt or Ink. Coral on any brand ground is too faint for small text. Only Schemes 3 and 4 (Cobalt and Ink) carry the speckle grain; a scheme you add has none.

settings.content: Instrument Serif and Bricolage Grotesque are both loaded site-wide. Reserve Instrument Serif for display moments (large titles, the positioning line) — never running body. Everything else is Bricolage Grotesque.
The header mark is a built-in SVG (light/dark variants) — set its scheme per section in the Header. Use the favicon for the browser-tab icon.

settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Shown when a link is shared on social. Must be a raster image (JPG/PNG) — most platforms will not render an SVG, so the logo cannot serve here. A page can override this with a custom.share_image metafield.
